description: Schemas of test types, not the real ear's (docs/control-port.md#type-schemas): the row vocabulary before any built-in type uses it. src/control/tests/type_schemas_test.cpp encodes its test specs and expects these schemas; the editor's form tests draw them. Holds a decimal row of each taper (a defaulted dB level whose minimum is silence, a required log-tapered frequency, an optional linear one with no unit), a defaulted flag, and two indexed families by one count row: a decimal trimDb.<n> applied in place and a flag invert.<n> that restarts the node, each member's key <key>.<n> from 1 to the count row's max.
